job.title: Hospitality Staff | Food Services
job.description:
South West Personnel (SWP) are seeking EOI for upcoming casual work opportunities from job seekers who have a background in hospitality, catering, food handling or support service.

If you are passionate about contributing to a caring, patient‑focused environment—we encourage you to apply! 

These roles support food service operations, onsite café and kitchen environments, offering a variety of shifts and work settings.  SWP are building a talent pool for kitchen and food service positions.  Duties can include:
  • Preparing, cooking and plating meals to required standards
  • Assisting with food prep, including chopping, batching and portioning
  • Preparing patient meals in line with dietary requirements
  • Maintaining strict food safety, hygiene and cleanliness standards
  • Dishwashing and cleaning of kitchen equipment and work areas
  • Supporting stock control, rotation and kitchen organisation
  • Assisting with café service, POS operation and basic food service
  • Delivering efficient, friendly service in a fast‑paced environment
For experienced, good fit candidates, there may be opportunity for advancement within the team.

To Be Successful, You Will Bring
  • Experience in food handling, kitchen or hospitality service
  • Strong understanding of food safety and hygiene practices
  • Knowledge of safe manual handling and workplace procedures
  • Reliability, flexibility and a team‑focused attitude
  • High standards of personal presentation and cleanliness
  • A genuine commitment to contributing to a caring environment
What’s on Offer

Depending on placement, benefits may include:
  • Competitive hourly rates
  • Potential for ongoing work, permanency and career progression
  • Varied shifts where penalty rates apply

job.title: Pulley Maintenance Changeouts
job.description:
South West Personnel is seeking reliable and safety-focused people to join an ongoing Tuesday Maintenance Crew, working one 12-hour day shift every Tuesday. 

This role may be a great fit if you are:
  • Between jobs or looking for additional work
  • Currently employed but are regularly available on Tuesdays
  • Studying and have flexibility to work Tuesdays
  • Looking for one consistent 12-hour shift each week
  • Interested in gaining hands-on experience within a mining environment
About the Role:

You’ll be working as part of a maintenance crew assisting with conveyor roller change-outs, general housekeeping and basic fixed plant maintenance support.
Previous mining experience is not required. What matters most is a strong work ethic, reliability and a genuine commitment to working safely.

This is a physically demanding role involving a 12-hour shift working outdoors and in the elements, so you’ll need to be comfortable with manual work and able to maintain a consistent work pace throughout the shift.

What is Essential:
  • Availability to work every Tuesday
  • Reside locally to Collie or surrounding South West areas
  • A current WA C Class Driver’s Licence and reliable transport
  • A good level of physical fitness and the ability to undertake manual work
  • Willingness to complete a pre-employment medical, drug and alcohol screen and functional assessment
  • A strong commitment to workplace safety and team outcomes
  • The maturity to work well as part of a crew and autonomously when required
  • High Risk tickets such as Working at Heights (mandatory) / Forklift / Crane, well regarded
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn
Why Work with South West Personnel?

We work closely with our client to ensure our casual employees are:
  • Well trained, supported and prepared for the work they undertake
  • Given the opportunity to gain valuable hands-on experience within the mining industry
  • Working with established organisations recognised as leaders in their field
APPLY NOW If you’re reliable, safety conscious and can commit to working every Tuesday, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Process Operators - Fixed Plant
job.description:
South West Personnel continues to work with local valued clients who are seeking quality Process Operators to work within their operational facilities.  These opportunities provide potential for permanency for best fit casual workers.

Application is now OPEN for quality candidates who have an interest in working as all-rounders within a production environment assisting with fixed plant tasks such as monitoring and controlling crushers, conveyors and processing circuits. 

You will be responsible for the day-to-day operation of the plant and must be able to work autonomously as well as part of the crew.  Typical tasks associated with routine fixed plant work may include:

  • The safe, efficient extraction, processing or manufacturing of raw materials, often working on rotating shift rosters in mining and manufacturing facilities.
  • Operational tasks of fixed pant to ensure safe production targets are met.
  • Conducting routine inspections, troubleshooting issues and optimising plant performance.
  • Routine housekeeping, clean up and operation al support such as minor maintenance tasks.
Requirements:
  • Priority to workplace safety, following and contributing to safe working practices.
  • Understanding of heavy industrial fixed plant operations.
  • Current WA drivers licence – HR, advantageous.
  • High Risk Forklift licence – LF, highly desirable.
  • Certificate in Process Plant Operations, well regarded.
These roles are subject to a pre-employment medical and drug screen and only shortlisted candidates residing in the SW of WA will be contacted for an interview at the SWP office in Bunbury.  SWP embraces diversity and encourages applications from people of all backgrounds.

job.title: Maintenance Electrician / Mechanical Fitter
job.description:
• Permanent Roles or Temp to commence
  • Multiple Opportunities
  • A-Grade Electrician | Mechanical Fitter – Fixed Plant
  • Day / Night / Weekends Rotating Shift Roster
  • Excellent Competitive Pay Rates + Allowances
About the Roles

Our Client, a Harvey based premium meat processing facility are seeking the professional services of trade qualified:
  1. A-Grade Electricians
  2. Mechanical Fitters
Responsible for maintaining meat processing fixed plant and associated equipment, responding to breakdowns and supporting initiatives to maximise plant availability for quality meat production.
  1. A-Grade Electrician Accountabilities:
  • Ensure compliance with AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules and relevant electrical standards
  • Complete daily, weekly, and monthly planned work orders through the MEX maintenance management system
  • Maintain the integrity and reliability of site electrical installations and equipment
  • Respond to electrical breakdowns during production to minimise downtime
  • Diagnose faults and undertake programming of PLCs, variable speed drives, MCCs and control systems
  • Analyse equipment failures and implement preventative measures to reduce recurring issues
  • Assist with electrical repairs, upgrades, shutdowns, and capital projects.
  1. Mechanical Fitter Accountabilities:
  • Perform maintenance and repairs on plant and production equipment
  • Complete daily, weekly and monthly planned work orders through the MEX maintenance system to ensure plant reliability and support production targets
  • Respond to mechanical breakdowns and perform timely fault diagnosis and repair
  • Troubleshoot equipment failures and process-related issues
  • Support preventative and predictive maintenance programs
  • Assemble and fit machined parts using precision fitting techniques
  • Drill, tap, machine and modify components, check tolerances clearances, alignment and operation of moving part – as required
  • Cut, thread, bend and install hydraulic and pneumatic pipes and lines.
Essential Requirements
  • Relevant trade qualification is essential
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Excellent fitting and fault-finding skills with experience in industrial maintenance environments
  • Strong PLC fault-finding and programming experience with sound knowledge of motors, drives, MCCs and industrial control systems
  • Ability to read and interpret relevant engineering drawings and pneumatic schematics
  • Machining experience including milling, turning and general workshop machining
  • Fabrication and welding experience in mild steel and stainless steel
  • A good understanding of Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) regulations, food processing, or meat industry (preferred but not essential)
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality and teamwork.

Already registered? Call Brody on 9721 8155 or email bpottshumphrey@southwestpersonnel.com.au to update your availability.

job.title: Blast Crew Operators
job.description:
South West Personnel are currently recruiting for Experienced Blast Crew Operators for ongoing casual opportunities, based in Boddington WA.  This is a rare opportunity for self-motivated, physically capable individuals to be considered for these roles.

Duties:

  • Daily preparation of shots in order to blast the pit floors – delineation, priming, loading, stemming and tying in.
  • Blast crew members may also assist other job roles including: Vacuum Drilling, Blast Hole Drilling, SME Operator or Fixed Plant Operator.
Requirements:

  • Must be a resident of Boddington or within Mandurah / Pinjarra / Dwellingup locations – DIDO / BIBO ONLY
  • Blast Operator experience, will be well regarded
  • Must be able to work a rotating Sportsmans Roster of 12hr days Monday to Sunday
  • Able to follow strict and rigid safety protocols, with demonstrated accuracy through a high level of attention to detail
  • Motivated and prepared to learn along with capability to focus on repetitive manual handling tasks through individual physical fitness
  • Willingness to successfully complete a pre-employment mining medical inclusive of D&A screen.
  • Have or be willing to get a Danger Goods Security Card
NOTE: although experience is preferred, consideration will be given to those with mining, drilling, civil construction and extensive labouring or trade assistant experience.

job.description:

There can be permanent full-time opportunities present for hard working and reliable operators that easily align with expectations around safety culture and behavioural ethics.
These roles offer a rare opportunity to work for an employer of choice and be close to home by residing within the greater Boddington region. 
Current vacancies with immediate starts are available for experienced, ticketed and competent Mining Operators in:
  
  • Rigid Dump Trucks (CAT 777s / CAT 785s or larger)
  • Rigid Dump Truck (Komatsu 785s / 830Es or larger)
  
To be considered you will:
  • Be prepared to commence on a Dump Truck and complete your VOC hours and all required site training prior to being considered for other machinery.
  • Have solid and recent experience with haul trucks and/or mobile plant operations within a mining environment.
  • Learn quickly and demonstrate competency through safe work practices and operating procedures.

  • Be fit and healthy – willing to undertake a pre-employment mining medical and random D&A testing.
  • Have availability to work a continuous shift rosterinvolving 12 hour shifts – 2 DS 2 NS: 5 OFF – 2 DS 3 NS: 4 OFF – 3 DS 2 NS: 3 OFF
  • Be flexible to attend registration interview and pre-employment medical in Bunbury or Rockingham plus client interview in Boddington, if required.
Only candidates meeting the desired experience level and who reside around Dwellingup, Pinjarra, Mandurah or are local to Boddington will be considered for these vacancies.
